Q7.answer: (a) MSPB. Notice 2026-08-31 before 2026-09-02, appeals rule applies only if notice issued on/after 2026-09-02; MSPB continues pre-effective-date RIF appeals. Documents: OPM appeals final 2026-15666 DATES, correction 2026-17338 (non-substantive, effective 2026-09-02), MSPB 2026-16456 DATES/preamble, main rule 2026-15665 DATES for retention version. (b) OPM. Must e-file in system identified on OPM website unless good-cause exemption approved, no email/postal absent good cause. Effective Fri 2026-12-18, day1 2026-12-19, day30 2027-01-17 Sunday, extended to first workday after, 11:59pm ET (2027-01-18, or 2027-01-19 if 2027-01-18 is federal holiday, not specified in documents). (c) Preponderance: timeliness, OPM jurisdiction, agency noncompliance with statute/OPM RIF regulation, prejudice causing action/loss materially more favorable outcome. No hearing as of right; written record unless hearing necessary and efficient for material fact/credibility. (d) Rule: sole/exclusive OPM procedure, may not be raised in negotiated grievance/arbitration.
